_instructions: Session task list texts. snapshot_heading opens the list in the instructions ({revision} is the list's revision when the snapshot was made); snapshot_rule follows it; snapshot_empty replaces the sections when there are none. step_line opens the one-line task state in each step's guidance message ({sections} lists each open section and its active step); fold_hint follows it while a section with steps has not started and another section is closed ({section} is its id). Edited in place; no compile. end_reminder is sent once per run when the agent ends its turn with open steps ({steps} names them); unfiled_reminder joins the step's guidance message once unfiled_after_calls tool calls since the user's last message include no task_list_write. user_change_heading opens each change the user made from the chat's task panel, which the agent receives with its next model call.
snapshot_heading: Session tasks: this session's working list, as of revision {revision}; it ends with the session. Track each multi-step piece of work in it with task_list_write as you go; read it with task_list_read.
snapshot_rule: If another session or a later day would need something, it belongs in Main Notes; a step of the work in front of you belongs here.
fold_hint: Before starting {section}: if it does not need the details of the closed work, set fold_earlier on the task_list_write that starts its first step.
end_reminder: Before you end this turn: {steps} are still open in the session task list. Finish them, mark them blocked or cancelled with task_list_write, or answer without calling a tool to end the turn with your earlier reply.
unfiled_reminder: Session tasks: this turn's tool work is not in the session task list yet; add or update a section with task_list_write.
user_change_heading: The user changed the session task list (revision {revision}):
